content.expected_result: Retain immutable prototype source and detect package tampering.
preconditions: A fresh Saga and an HTML source directory are available.

steps.action: Import the HTML into the current prototype and its content-addressed assets, edit only the original source directory, then tamper with the stored asset.
steps.expected_result: Original source edits leave the stored current prototype and asset bytes unchanged; tampering with the content-addressed asset produces a digest mismatch.

content.title: Retain immutable prototype source and detect package tampering
